metadata.case_name: NG KAI HO v. WONG KING FAI T/A WING TAK CONSTRUCTIONS AND ENGINEERING AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: Left forearm laceration with tendon cut (flexor carpi radialis)
source: Physical examination revealed a 3cm laceration on the left arm. No neurovascular deficit was noted. He was then admitted to the Orthopaedic ward of AHMLNH where 60% cut of flexor carpi radialis (FCR) tendon at musculotendinous junction was revealed and repaired. Splint was fitted after the operation.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration of other flexor muscle, fascia or tendon at forearm level

injuries.description: Sensory deficit: 50% reduction in sensation to touch over volar forearm and distal to scar
source: 50% reduction in sensation to touch over volar forearm and distal to scar.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of cutaneous sensory nerve at forearm level

injuries.description: Well healed oblique scar over volar aspect of mid forearm (6 cm)
source: 6 cm oblique scar over volar aspect of mid forearm, well healed.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified superficial injury of forearm

manifestations.description: Numbness around scar with sense of discomfort
Left forearm pain, stiffness and weakness
50% reduction in sensation to touch over volar forearm and distal to scar
Avoids using left upper limb; maximal weight he can lift is around 30kg

treatments_received: 60% cut of flexor carpi radialis (FCR) tendon at musculotendinous junction was revealed and repaired.
Splint was fitted after the operation.
Referred to the physiotherapy department at United Christian Hospital (UCH) on 15 July 2013 (defaulted treatment after 31 July 2013).
Referred to occupational therapy department at AHMLNH on 23 September 2013 for work capacity evaluation.
Follow-up treatments/consultations (11 follow up treatments claimed).

losses.description: Reduced function of left forearm (tendon injury, weakness, reduced lifting capacity and avoidance of using left upper limb)
Well healed 6 cm oblique scar over volar aspect of mid forearm causing residual scar discomfort

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Unable to resume sports following injury
